title: Paid-chat guard cannot price media, album, voice/video note, checklist or plain forward sends: their builders write options:null and set_paid only fills an existing options object
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who charges Stars per message (or a paid channel DM). Attach a photo (or record a voice note, send a checklist, or forward messages from the share box without Silent/Schedule) and press Send. Confirm the 'Pay N Stars' box (or have 'Don't ask again' trust stored).
effect: PaidGuard::screen holds the request; release_paid_send sends HeldSend::with_price(), but set_paid (src/paid_messages_guard.rs:81-85) skips because options is null, so the send goes out with no paid_message_star_count. TDLib refuses it (payment required), and the message the user agreed to pay for fails. The trusted path (screen, :140-142) has the same no-op. Only text/dice/sticker/game sends, which build a messageSendOptions object, work. Tests (connect/tests/paid_messages_guard.rs) use hand-written JSON with an options object, so they miss it.
fix: Make set_paid write a full messageSendOptions object when options is null (or have every send builder always emit message_send_options), and test the guard with JSON from the real builders.

title: resendMessages always sends paid_message_star_count 0 and goes around the paid-message guard
trigger: In a chat that charges Stars per message, a send fails with a retryable state (for example the price went up: messageSendingStateFailed.required_paid_message_star_count > 0). Right-click the failed message and choose Retry send.
effect: resend_failed_message (connect/messages/edit.rs:266) builds resendMessages with paid_message_star_count 0. PaidGuard::screen only looks at '"@type":"send' and 'forwardM', so 'resendMessages' is never priced or confirmed. In a paid chat the retry fails again every time, and nothing asks the user to pay.
fix: Put resendMessages through the paid guard (count = message_ids.len()) or pass the failed state's required_paid_message_star_count after a confirmation.

title: Outgoing typing is keyed by chat only; sendChatAction is built with topic_id null and routed by whatever thread is open at send time
trigger: In a forum or a channel's comments, type into the composer in thread/topic A, then open topic B of the same chat (or go back to the chat) within 4 s.
effect: OutgoingTyping { chat_id, last_sent_ms } (connect/typing.rs) has no topic, so a thread change inside the same chat neither cancels A nor starts B (prev.chat_id == chat_id, inside the interval). The later chatActionCancel goes through thread_routed with the new thread's topic, so A keeps showing 'typing' until the server times it out, and the cancel goes to the wrong topic. For an admin in a channel's direct messages with a topic open, direct_routed leaves sendChatAction at topic null, so the typing does not reach that conversation.
fix: Key OutgoingTyping by (ChatId, Option<TopicId>), pass the topic into send_chat_action_kind, and cancel when that key changes.

title: Auction state fetch is three fields kept in step by hand (auction_request, auction_loading, auction_ready), plus UI pending_auction; the error arm clears loading without matching the request id
trigger: Open an auction from one gift link, then quickly another before the first getGiftAuctionState answers; the first request fails.
effect: The error arm (state/domains/payments/gift_market.rs:284-286) sets auction_loading = false for any AuctionState failure, not only when it matches market.auction_request. gift_market_frame_upkeep (ui/gift_market_ui.rs:231-243) then sees !loading with no ready id and drops pending_auction, so the second auction's box never opens even when its answer arrives.
fix: One AuctionFetch enum (Idle | Loading { request } | Ready { gift_id } | Failed) where the answer and the error both apply only when the request id matches.

title: A text reply to a story sends clear_draft: true, so TDLib deletes the draft the user has in the poster's chat
trigger: 1. Open the private chat with Alice, type a message and leave it as a draft. 2. Open Alice's story from the story tray. 3. Type a reply in the story viewer's reply field and send it (ConnectDriver story reply, connect/stories/posting.rs:115 -> send_text_story_reply).
effect: The reply is sent to the chat with Alice, and TDLib also deletes that chat's draft (schema td_api.tl:6726 'Pass true to delete message draft in the chat'). The text typed in step 1 is gone. The story reply field is not that chat's composer; Quill already keeps the draft for sends that are not the composer's content (SendOptions::literal_text, composer/send.rs:104-107).
fix: Send clear_draft: false from send_text_story_reply (as the sticker/GIF/voice story replies and the dice already do), so only a send of the chat's own composer content clears its draft.

title: A poll's deadline is two fields, open_period and close_date, that must not both be set
trigger: Poll composer: pick a preset period, then 'Custom' date (or the reverse). PollDraft (src/poll.rs:407-412) keeps both values, and open_period_secs (src/poll.rs:451-455) and validate (src/poll.rs:495-505) decide by hand that close_date wins. PollSend passes both through to inputMessagePoll.
effect: No bug today: open_period_secs zeroes the period when close_date > 0. But every reader must repeat the 'close_date wins' rule, and a new caller that builds PollSend from the draft fields directly sends both, which TDLib rejects.
fix: One enum PollDeadline { None, Period(i32), Until(i32) } in PollDraft and PollSend; send_poll maps it to the two schema fields.

title: Wallet transaction lookup answer is not matched to the transaction that was clicked
trigger: In a chat, click a Gram transfer card A whose transaction is not in the loaded Money history (open_wallet_transaction sends getTonWalletTransaction, tx_loading = true). Before it answers, click transfer card B (also not in history): a second lookup goes out with tx_loading still true. Alternatively, click a row B in the history list (select_wallet_tx shows B but leaves tx_loading true).
effect: A's answer lands first, passes the only guard (purpose == Transaction && tx_loading, src/state/domains/payments/ton_wallet.rs:72-77) and shows A's details. B's answer then finds tx_loading false and is dropped, or in the history-row case A's late answer replaces B's details. The user clicked B and sees A's amount, address and date.
fix: Make the lookup one value, e.g. `TxDetail { None, Loading { id: String }, Shown(WalletTx), Failed(String) }`. Put the transaction id on the pending request or purpose, and apply an answer only when it matches the `Loading` id.

title: Money page detail view is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Every detail transition: show_wallet_transaction, select_wallet_nft, money_back, set_money_tab and open_wallet_transaction each clear a different subset of selected_tx / selected_nft / tx_loading / tx_error / hint_open.
effect: Two of them can be set at once, for example selected_tx together with tx_loading (see 07-4-001), or selected_nft together with tx_error. The render order in ui/ton_wallet_money.rs:197-208 decides which one wins.
fix: `enum MoneyDetail { Overview, Tx { tx: WalletTx, hint: bool }, Nft(String), TxLookup { id: String }, TxFailed(String) }` as the one field of the page's detail stage.

title: Paged<T> holds loading/loaded/error bools beside each other, and page answers carry no page key
trigger: fetch_wallet_history/fetch_wallet_nfts set loading=true and error=None. apply sets loading=false, loaded=true and error=None, and fail sets loading=false and error. Closing and reopening the Money page while a page request is in flight lets the old answer (keyed only by purpose and append) land on the new page and clear its loading while the new request is still out.
effect: Today the list corrects itself when the newer answer lands, but loading can read false while a request is in flight. `loaded && error.is_some()` and `loading && error` are representable.
fix: Use a `Fetch`-like stage, e.g. `PageStage { Idle, Loading { offset: String }, Ready, Failed(String) }`, and put the asked offset (or a page generation) in the purpose, so an answer applies only to the request that is current.

title: TonWalletState uses three 'in flight or done' bools for the app config, wallet state and exchange-rate requests
trigger: fetch_ton_explorer_url, open_money_page and set_can_use set and clear explorer_url_requested, state_requested and rates_requested by hand. One bool stands for both 'asked' and 'answered'.
effect: The value cannot tell an in-flight request from a finished one or a failed one, so a failure path has to remember to clear it (see 07-4-005).
fix: Use one `Fetch<()>`/`Fetch<Rates>` per request (idle, loading, ready, failed), and have the error arm of each purpose move it to failed so it can be retried.

title: A failed getApplicationConfig for the wallet leaves explorer_url_requested set for the whole session
trigger: Open Settings > Money while getApplicationConfig fails (network error, flood wait). fetch_ton_explorer_url sets explorer_url_requested=true after the send, and RequestPurpose::GetTonExplorerUrl has no error arm that clears it: only purpose.rs and connect/ton_wallet.rs name it. Close and reopen Money.
effect: The request is never asked again this session. ton_usd_rate stays None, so every fiat line on the Money page reads a dash until restart (unless another feature's app-config answer happens to bring the rate). Related: open_money_page sets state_requested and rates_requested before send_wallet(..)?, so a failed send leaves them true too and returns early, skipping the history fetch.
fix: Make the app-config fetch a `Fetch` stage whose error arm (add GetTonExplorerUrl to the payments error routing) moves it back to retryable. Set the flags only after a successful send, or reset them on Err.

title: Hidden translate bars are app-wide and keyed by bare chat id, so hiding one leaks to other accounts
trigger: On account A, hide the translate bar in a channel or private chat (set_translate_bar_hidden -> TranslatePrefs::set_bar_hidden(chat_id)). Switch to account B and open the same peer, for example the same public channel, or B's private chat with A's user (which has the id of A's Saved Messages).
effect: B's translate bar for that chat is hidden too, although B never hid it. TranslatePrefs is the app's file (ui/translate_ui/mod.rs:118, settings/app_prefs.rs), while tdesktop keeps the hidden flag per account on the server.
fix: Key the hidden chats by owner (`Vec<AccountChat>` / `HashMap<AccountKey, Vec<ChatId>>`), or move them into the account's own prefs file.

title: Tray menu's notification and sound toggles work while Quill is locked
trigger: Lock Quill with the passcode. Open the tray menu and click 'Disable notifications' or 'Disable notification sounds'.
effect: main.rs:499-510 calls set_desktop_notifications / set_inapp_sounds_enabled with no refused_while_locked check. The on-screen account's setting flips and is saved from behind the lock. tdesktop hides the notifications toggle while locked (docs/decisions/lock-is-a-render-state.md, tray.cpp). Tray::new always builds both items, and sync_tray never learns the lock.
fix: Pass the lock into sync_tray so the menu model drops or disables the toggles while locked (the SNI menu too), and refuse ToggleNotifications/ToggleSounds in the tray action dispatch via refused_while_locked.

title: Turning the tray icon off while it is still registering leaves an orphan tray icon that nothing can remove
trigger: Linux with a slow session bus: start Quill (tray registering, Phase::Connecting), switch Settings > 'Show tray icon' off before registration finishes; later switch it on again.
effect: hide() drops the Receiver and goes Idle; the worker thread then finishes tray.spawn(), its send fails and the Handle is dropped without shutdown(). ksni's service loop only stops on HandleRequest::Shutdown (a closed handle channel just disables that select arm), so the icon stays in the tray with its menu live although the setting says off; switching it back on registers a second icon. Needs a restart.
fix: Make the registration worker own the outcome: Phase::Connecting carries a cancel flag (or the worker sends to a channel it checks) and the worker calls handle.shutdown() when the receiver is gone; or keep Connecting until it lands and then shut it down in the Ready arm when hidden.

title: A hidden account export pops its progress box open again after switching accounts and back
trigger: Settings > Data & Storage > Export Telegram data > Start, press Hide; switch to account B; switch back to account A while the export still runs.
effect: DialogUi (OnScreen) is rebuilt on each switch, so account_export_progress_hidden is back to false while A's Session still holds settings.account_export; the AccountExport is_open (`!hidden && export.is_some()`) is true and the progress box opens unasked over A's main window.
fix: Keep whether the progress is shown with the export itself (an AccountExport view stage in the Session next to account_export, or derive 'shown' from an explicit Open request), not in a screen flag whose default means 'shown'.

title: The Export Telegram data box's mode is three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: The box is Options(draft) when account_export_dialog is Some, Progress when the session has an export and account_export_progress_hidden is false, Hidden when the flag is true; account_export_seen caches the last progress. Every close path (on_close, .close, Cancel, Done, Hide, the poll) writes a different subset of them.
fix: enum AccountExportBox { Closed, Options(AccountExportDraft), Progress { seen: Option<AccountProgress> }, Hidden }, with the export's existence read from the session.

title: A failed account switch has already torn down the screen, and a failed set_active_account leaves no account on screen
trigger: Accounts > Switch to another account when the app root is unavailable or credentials are missing (screen wiped, old account kept), or when writing the active-account record fails (read-only or full disk).
effect: end_account_surfaces (farewell + replace_screen, new epoch) runs before the safe_app_root/credentials checks, so the first failures close the open chat and every box while self.live stays the same account. If set_active_account fails, retire_live_to_background already moved the client away and the function returns with self.live None: the window shows no account, and the Accounts dialog still marks the old account Active (from disk) with no Switch button for it, so only a restart brings it back.
fix: Check everything that can fail (root, credentials, the active-account write) before end_account_surfaces/retire_live_to_background, or roll back by adopting the retired client; put_on_screen should be the one place where live and the screen change together.

title: Log out from the Account box leaves the typed 2FA password and reason in the box's text fields
trigger: Settings > Account: type the 2FA password (or a reason) in the delete-account section, then press Log out > Log out.
effect: submit_logout clears only confirm_logout and open; the shell then closes the kit dialog with window.close_dialog, which does not run on_close, so close_account_lifecycle (which empties reason and password) never runs. The password stays in the TextareaState until the screen is replaced, against the A2 rule the box documents.
fix: Have submit_logout go through close_account_lifecycle, or make the box's open state an enum whose leaving drops the inputs (Option<LifecycleBox { reason, password, confirm }>).

title: Account box: open, confirm_delete and confirm_logout are one stage held as three bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Both inline confirms can be armed at once (press Log out, then Permanently delete); each closer resets a different subset (submit_logout skips the inputs, submit_delete_account resets only confirm_delete).
fix: Option<AccountBox { confirm: Confirm::{None, Delete, LogOut}, reason, password }> with one close that drops it.

title: Account box reads TTL, auto-delete and password-state fetches as loading/busy bools next to error options
trigger: n/a
effect: account_ttl_loading + account_ttl_days + account_error, account_mutating, default_auto_delete_busy + default_auto_delete_error, password_state_loading + password_state are each a loading flag beside a value/error pair; open_account_lifecycle clears the error fields by hand because a cached value skips the fetch that would.
fix: Fetch<i32> for the TTL and the auto-delete time, Fetch<PasswordState> for the password state, and one Mutation { Idle, Running, Failed(String) } for the setters.

title: Age verification prompt: age_verify_open and age_verify_started are stages of one flow
trigger: n/a
effect: The gate is NotAsked / Prompting / Started held as two bools written in updates_sync_ui.rs and account_notices.rs.
fix: enum AgeGate { Idle, Prompting, Started } on AccountBoxes.

title: Recent-actions poll is an Option<ChatId> 'running' flag beside a detached task, plus a hooked bool
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll says a detached spawn_scoped loop is running for a chat; the task is not stored, so the flag and the task are kept in step by the task clearing it through the main window at its end. event_log_hooked is a set-once 'started' flag for the scroll handler.
fix: Store the poll as Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)> so dropping it stops the loop and its presence is the running state.

title: The Experimental settings page reads the system clipboard on every render
trigger: Settings > Advanced > Experimental settings, leave it open while chats update.
effect: experimental_settings_page calls cx.read_from_clipboard() each time the page renders to decide whether Import shows. On X11/Wayland a clipboard read is a round trip to the selection owner, done on the UI thread on every QuillApp notify while the page is open; the Import button also does not appear when the clipboard changes until something else redraws.
fix: Read the clipboard once when the page opens (and on window focus), keeping the result in the page's state.

title: Fast buttons mode invalidates only the main window's history rows
trigger: Turn on fast buttons (the numberbuttons code) or toggle it in Experimental settings while a chat window is open with bot buttons.
effect: set_experimental_option clears self.history.rows_key, the main window's slot only; a chat window keeps its cached rows without (or with) the digits until its next history refresh.
fix: Invalidate the rows of every WindowSlot (or key the row cache by the fast-buttons mode).

title: Two UI-driver input commands run at once and interleave their steps
trigger: An agent issues ui_type and ui_click (or two agents drive) in parallel tool calls.
effect: bridge::take() hands every waiting command to agent_driver_start, which spawns one task each; the tasks await frames and glides between steps, so a click of one lands between the characters of the other. check_step compares only the surface, so the typed text continues into whatever the other command focused, and guard::take_refusals / agent_bridge.ui_send (process- and app-wide slots) can be credited to the wrong command's reply.
fix: Run input commands one at a time: a driver stage on the app (Idle | Running { id }) that queues further input commands until the running one answers.

title: ui_send is an app-wide slot not keyed to the command or account that produced it
trigger: A composer send under the driver whose agent_route_send runs in a deferred effect after the step's take (a with_injecting deferred half), then an account switch or another command.
effect: AgentBridge::ui_send is a QuillApp (app-wide) Option taken after each step by whichever command runs next; it carries chat_id but no account or command id, so a late send would be delivered with another command's reply, possibly after a switch to another account.
fix: Carry the request id (and screen epoch) in UiSend and only take a send whose id matches the running command; drop it on screen change.

title: The agent tree is the last drawn frame's, but it is checked against the surface of the state now
trigger: With chat G granted and chat X not: while an agent's read_ui_tree waits for a frame, the user opens X and then G again within one 16 ms poll, before the frame for G is drawn.
effect: agent_tree computes driver_surface from current state (granted chat G) but reads window.a11y_tree_snapshot() of the last frame, which shows X. The conversation slot is tagged REGION_CHAT only (no chat=<id> tag), so redact allows its content and X's messages reach the agent.
fix: Tag the conversation region with chat_tag(open chat) so redaction follows the frame's own chat, or record the surface each frame is drawn for and compare it with the frame read.

title: Apply-in-place answer rewrites a byte range (or the whole field) recorded at the press, with no check that the draft is unchanged
trigger: In a chat, type a draft, select a word and press the AI apply shortcut; before the answer lands, keep typing earlier in the field (or select-all and type a new draft). The answer arrives.
effect: The answer replaces the stale range (now covering different text) or, with no selection, the whole field, so text typed while waiting is overwritten without a word.
fix: Keep the field's text (or a revision) in ApplyInPlace and drop the answer (with a toast) when the composer no longer holds it, as the conversation key is already checked.

title: Style preview's example load is four fields kept in step: example, example_token, example_asked_at and StyleExamples::loading
trigger: Every path in style_preview.rs (load_ai_style_example, ai_style_example_upkeep, the send-failure arm) sets or clears the token, the start time and the loading bool by hand.
effect: No bug found today; a new exit (close, error) must remember all three or the spinner/60 fps tick and the token disagree.
fix: One `ExampleStage { Idle, Loading { token, asked_at }, Failed }` beside the shown example (or `Fetch<StyleExample>` keyed by token); StyleExamples keeps only the count.

title: Style notices are not matched to the preview that asked: Added closes any open preview, Removed/Deleted closes any preview in Removing, and Removing has no exit on failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link of your own installed style, press Delete Style and confirm while the request cannot be sent (or deleteTextCompositionStyle fails). Or: press Add Style in one preview and, before the answer, a second preview replaces it.
effect: A failed or unsent delete does nothing visible (send result ignored with `let _`, DeleteStyle error is silent) and the preview stays in PreviewStage::Removing; the next Removed/Deleted notice from any request closes it. An Added notice for style X takes (closes) a preview showing style Y.
fix: Make PreviewStage::Removing/Adding carry the RequestId (or style name) and put the request id in StyleNotice; leave Removing on that request's error or a send failure.

title: Add Style has no in-flight stage and ignores a send failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link and click Add Style twice quickly, or click it while the request cannot be sent.
effect: Two addTextCompositionStyle requests go out (the second can fail with an error toast); a send failure shows nothing and the button stays as if nothing was pressed.
fix: A PreviewStage::Adding { request } variant that disables the button and is left on the answer, the error or a send failure (with the error toast).

title: A custom emoji id is marked asked on a send error and on send, and the UI never asks again if the lookup fails
trigger: Open the AI compose box while the getCustomEmojiStickers lookup for a style pill's emoji fails (network error) or resolve_custom_emoji returns Err.
effect: The style pill / editor / preview icon stays the Sparkles fallback for the rest of the account's screen; only an account switch clears emoji_asked. (Unconfirmed whether the driver's own lookup retries the id.)
fix: Do not insert on Err, and key the asked set to the outcome (Fetch per id, cleared on failure) so a failed lookup is asked again.

title: Style editor's save stage lives in two places kept in step by hand: StyleEditor::save (UI) and AiComposeState::style_save (session)
trigger: submit_ai_style_editor sets save=Sent; the session sets style_save in wait_for_style_save; open_ai_style_editor calls forget_style_save; dismissing the editor (ai_compose_dismissed) drops the editor but leaves style_save set.
effect: No bug found today (the answer is matched by RequestId and every editor open forgets the old save), but the Sent stage has no exit except the matched answer, so a lost answer leaves Create disabled until Esc.
fix: StyleSave::Sent { request: RequestId } in the editor, matched against the answer's request id, with the session only holding answers.

title: Takeover pill bounds are the main window's but are compared with the pointer of whichever window's input probe fired
trigger: While an agent drives, click near the top centre of a chat window (where the main window's pill sits in main-window coordinates).
effect: The click counts as on the pill, so it does not pause the agent; the user's input in that chat window is ignored by the takeover.
fix: Record the pill's window id with its bounds (or keep it per window) and treat input as on_controls only when the event's window is the one that painted the pill.

title: Appearance page re-sends getInstalledBackgrounds on every render after it fails (request loop, 'Loading wallpapers' forever)
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance while getInstalledBackgrounds answers with an error (e.g. a FLOOD_WAIT or any TDLib error) and keep the page open.
effect: The error arm (state/domains/chats/error.rs:37-46) only sets chats_state.background_error; installed_backgrounds stays None. ensure_wallpapers_loaded is called from the page's render (settings_window/pages.rs:98) and re-sends whenever installed_backgrounds is None and none is pending, so each error answer re-renders the page and sends the request again, while the gallery shows 'Loading wallpapers...' next to the 'Couldn't update wallpapers' line indefinitely.
fix: Hold the gallery as Fetch<Vec<Background>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) and request only from Idle (and on an explicit retry), not from render; background_error for the other eight purposes stays separate.

title: Story cover editor, privacy editor and composer edit all wait on one unkeyed manage slot, so one call's answer closes another's panel as saved
trigger: In the story viewer, Save the privacy editor of a story (privacy_sent), then before its answer start another management call (Edit story > Save from the composer, or the cover editor's Save) for the same or another story. StoryManageState is one slot: the second start() takes it, so the first call's answer is ignored.
effect: When the second call answers, story_frame_upkeep sees manage.pending false and clears cover_sent, privacy_sent and save_sent together, judging success by the slot-wide manage.error (not error_for(chat, story)): the privacy panel closes as saved though its own answer was never read (it may have failed), or the composer shows the other call's error. fail_locally on another story also releases the waiters with the wrong error.
fix: Each waiter keeps the RequestId it sent (an enum Saving { request } / Editing on the panel), and the upkeep settles it only from the answer to that request; or key StoryManageState by request id instead of one slot.

title: Story composer's post flow is three bools plus local_error kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (check_sent -> post_sent, save_sent, local_error set and cleared in story_composer.rs and frame_upkeep.rs)
effect: check_sent, post_sent and save_sent are mutually exclusive stages of one send (checking eligibility, posting, saving an edit) with local_error beside them; each writer must clear the others. Listed as baseline debt in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt.
fix: enum ComposerSend { Idle, Checking { request }, Posting { request }, Saving { request }, Failed(String) } on the composer, matched to the answer's request id.

title: Custom theme list is Option<Vec> plus Option<Task> (a hand-rolled Fetch)
trigger: n/a (custom_themes in reads.rs, refresh_custom_themes)
effect: custom = None with custom_read = Some means loading, custom = Some means ready; the two are kept in step in reads.rs:192-200 and refresh_custom_themes. A failed folder read cannot be represented (it is an empty list).
fix: One enum CustomThemes { Unread, Reading(Task<()>), Read(Vec<CustomTheme>) }.

title: Omarchy probe held as omarchy_probed bool beside omarchy Option, plus omarchy_watched
trigger: n/a
effect: omarchy_probed=false is 'not looked yet', probed+None is 'not on Omarchy', probed+Some is 'found'; omarchy_watched is a separate started flag for the watcher task (which is detached, so it cannot be stopped).
fix: enum Omarchy { Unprobed, Absent, Found { state, watch: Option<Task<()>> } } so the watcher is owned and stops with it.

title: Deleting a custom theme that fails on disk still switches the app away from it
trigger: Settings > Appearance, select a custom theme, press Delete when the file cannot be removed (read-only themes folder, permission error).
effect: delete_custom_theme shows the error toast but still resets the day/night slot to the built-in default, so the theme is unapplied while its tile (re-read from the folder) is still there.
fix: Reset the slots only when store::delete returned Ok.

title: Renaming a custom theme in the editor deletes the old file but leaves the other day/night slot naming it
trigger: Have custom theme 'Mine' (light) as the day theme; Edit it, change it to dark colours and rename it 'Mine2'; Save.
effect: save_theme_editor deletes 'Mine' and choose_app_theme puts 'Mine2' in the night slot only; the day slot still names the deleted 'Mine', so in day mode Quill silently falls back to the default theme (delete_custom_theme clears such slots, the rename path does not).
fix: On a rename, repoint every slot that named the old theme to the new name (or reset it), the same way delete_custom_theme does.

title: Turning spell check on re-checks only the main window's composer
trigger: Open a chat in a separate chat window and type a misspelled word with spell check off; in the main window go to Settings > Chats and turn 'Check spelling' on.
effect: The switch handler runs sync_spellcheck on self.composer, the main window's slot only; the chat window's composer shows no underlines until its text changes (composer_ui.spelling is per window).
fix: Run the re-check in every window (in_every_window), as set_chat_prefs already does for the submit-on-Enter mode.

title: Folder step and community mode clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so the Calls tab stays over a folder switch
trigger: Open the sidebar Calls tab, then press the Next/Previous Folder shortcut (NextFolder/PrevFolder -> step_folder_by_key -> open_folder_tab), or click a community row's View chats (enter_community_chat_list_mode, line 294)
effect: The folder or community view changes invisibly under the Calls list; the same step from the Contacts tab returns to the chats, from Calls it does nothing visible. open_archive_folder (archive_row.rs:114) and open_chats_tab clear both flags, these two clear only one
fix: Replace the two bools with one `SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls }` enum so any view change sets `Chats` in one write.

title: Sidebar tab held as two mutually exclusive bools (contacts_tab_open, calls_tab_open) kept in step by hand at ~10 sites
trigger: n/a (see the folder-step bug for the live consequence)
effect: Every writer must remember to clear the other flag; both true is representable
fix: `tab: SidebarTab` enum.

title: 'Hide new chats?' box reopens after Cancel/Esc when hideSuggestedAction cannot be sent
trigger: The suggestion box is up while the client is not on the chats path (auth not Ready or shutdown started, e.g. during a log-out/close); press Cancel or Esc
effect: hide_suggested_action returns Err before removing the action locally, so archive_mute_suggested() stays true: the shell reopens the box and every close adds another 'could not hide' error toast
fix: Remove the action locally (or record a per-account 'dismissed' value) regardless of the send result, so the box's open state does not depend on the request succeeding.

title: AudioEngine stage is spread over track/building/sim_clock Options plus failed, start_failed, stale bools, parked_secs and error
trigger: n/a
effect: state() derives the stage from priority order of the fields (failed beats building, so a retry build after a failure reads Failed until it lands instead of Loading); combos like failed+building or stale+building are representable
fix: One `Stage { Idle, Building{..}, Loaded{track, stale_at: Option<f64>}, Failed{at, error}, Simulated(PlaybackClock) }` enum with the error inside the failing variant.

title: Output device lifecycle held as device Option, opening bool, failed_at Option and watched bool
trigger: n/a
effect: Closed/Opening/Open/Failed are kept in step by hand in open, install, Reopened::drop and look; e.g. device Some with opening true is representable
fix: `DeviceStage { Closed, Opening, Open{device, watched}, Failed{at} }`.

title: Idle watch thread spawned with std::thread::Builder, not spawn_guarded (panic-safety rule 11); a panic in look leaves watched=true forever
trigger: Any panic inside look() on the quill-audio-idle thread
effect: No new watch is ever started, so the output device is never closed after silence (keeps the Mac from idle sleep) and a stale device is only noticed by the next open
fix: Spawn through quill::thread_guard::spawn_guarded and clear `watched` in a drop guard, as Reopened does for `opening`.

title: Each refresh_system_accent while a Linux read is pending starts another 100 ms poll loop
trigger: With 'use system accent' on, on Linux, switch to Quill repeatedly (window activation) while the gdbus/gsettings read is still running (up to the desktop query time limit)
effect: Several identical 100 ms poll tasks run at once, each re-applying the appearance when the read lands; wasted wakes, no wrong state
fix: Keep the poll as one stored Task (e.g. `accent_poll: Option<Task<()>>`) and skip starting a second while it is set.

title: Test position_follows_the_frames_the_device_consumed sleeps 300 ms on the wall clock
trigger: cargo test
effect: Violates the deterministic-tests rule (no sleeps); slows the suite
fix: Drop the sleep; the frame-count assertion already shows no time-based advance, or use the engine's manual clock.
